result.question: Why does Micah think Yahweh favors him?

readings.answer: Because a Levite became his priest.
readings.support: because a Levite has become my priest.

assessments.reason: Micah says, “Now I know that the LORD will be good to me, because a Levite has become my priest” (17:13), matching the answer that he thinks Yahweh favors him because he has a Levite priest.

result.reason: Verse 17:13 explicitly states Micah’s reasoning: because a Levite became his priest.
